description:
Performance is a first-class adoption concern. One reference page states gf2's performance claims, how they are measured, and the commit-pinned evidence behind each.

## Background

No evidence class in the tree carries every required field in-file; the commit field comes from the pinned link (`dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` §3.10). Receipt bytes never change.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/reference/` states the measurement methodology (statistical treatment, warm-up, host control and comparison basis) in freshly authored prose.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each claim links to commit-pinned evidence (a repository URL at a fixed commit) and states hardware, build flags, dataset or workload, baseline and measurement date, taken from that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-03: Claims are concise and non-marketing; no volatile result table is hand-copied; a claim appears only where current commit-pinned evidence exists.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each claim has a stable anchor for other pages to link.
- [hard] REQ-05: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links and anchors resolve.
title: Write the performance evidence reference page
